correctness.rationale: Exact stationary moment equations yield u1=D/k and u0=(Da/b)(1/k+2/(a+b)); j+Lg=µ pointwise for g0=kx²/2+Dk/(a+b), g1=0. The signed work+g martingale has Brownian bracket 2Dk²x² in the off state and constant jump amplitudes ±Dk/(a+b); evaluating the stationary bracket gives V. Fourth-moment finiteness bounds endpoint variance; ergodic bracket convergence and bounded jump sizes give a martingale CLT. Rational consistency checks and independent 12-state mixed moment ODE validation passed.

value.rationale: A mean-power-only prediction obscures large fluctuations: for all fixed on/off occupation ratios, the rate-independent dissipated power coexists with a strictly decreasing exact temporal variance, a 1/λ divergence at slow switching and a sharp fast-switching nonzero floor. The observable directly quantifies energetic reliability in experimental intermittent optical traps, and the simple cancellation structure is a reusable exact martingale identity, rather than mere rescaling or finite-case numerology.
